hero.lede: We choose every gem, draw every setting and work the metal by hand so the piece you receive is one of a kind.
home.feature1.title: Every piece begins as a sketch
home.feature1.body: We design by hand, select certified gems and set them with inherited techniques. Nothing leaves the bench without passing under the master jeweler's loupe.
home.feature2.title: Fair gold and traceable gems
home.feature2.body: We work with responsibly sourced gold and certified gems. We know where every material comes from and we are glad to show you.
home.promo.title: Bespoke pieces and private appointments
home.promo.body: We design engagement rings and one-of-a-kind pieces with you, in person.
gallery.title: Pieces on display
gallery.lede: Each card is a real piece with its hallmark: metal, gem and carats. They rotate with availability.
stories.title: Stories of craft and gems
stories.lede: Long notes on design, materials and the hands behind every jewel.
contact.title: Let's talk about your jewel
contact.lede: Bespoke piece, a workshop visit or press? Tell us and the team replies in 1-2 days.
